content.question: What do generative models attempt to model?
options: The joint distribution of input and output - how the data is generated, including the structure of the inputs themselves.
Only the conditional probability of the output given the input.
A decision boundary that separates the classes as widely as possible.
The pairwise distances between individual training examples.
content.answer: The joint distribution of input and output - how the data is generated, including the structure of the inputs themselves.
